runs.note: Register model with RO/W1C semantics; random transfers to the mapped addresses.
All 16 addresses with idle cycles; write / reset / read-back-all sequence.

summary: Checks prdata (where defined), pslverr and pready every cycle against a register model with RW, RO and W1C semantics. Covers every register read and write, both error kinds, idle cycles and reset-after-traffic. The read-back-after-reset sequence was what caught wrong reset values.
